name: Fighter
description: A master of martial arts, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. High constitution and strength, with a focus on physical combat. Starts with a 1 handed weapon and shield.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Twice per rest, you can use an action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + constitution modifier.
attack_descs: You take a deep breath and focus your energy, allowing you to recover from your wounds.
You feel a surge of adrenaline as you push through the pain, regaining your strength.
You tap into your inner reserves of stamina, healing yourself in the process.

abilities.name: Power Strike
abilities.description: 3 times per rest, you can make a powerful strike that deals 2d6 damage plus your strength modifier.
attack_descs: You gather your might and unleash a devastating blow on (t)
You channel your strength into a powerful strike against (t)
You swing your (w) with all your might, aiming to shatter (t)
attack_misses: You swing with all your might, but (t) dodges out of the way.
You channel your strength into a powerful strike, but (t) manages to block it.
You gather your might and unleash a devastating blow, but (t) evades it.

name: Wizard
description: A scholarly spellcaster who wields powerful arcane magic. Wizards are fragile but have immense destructive and utility potential through spells.

abilities.name: Fire Bolt
abilities.description: Hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object.
attack_descs: You point your finger and a mote of fire streaks toward (t).
A small bolt of fire leaps from your hand toward (t).
You conjure a fiery projectile and launch it at (t).

abilities.name: Ray of Frost
abilities.description: A beam of cold energy strikes a creature, slowing it.
attack_descs: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward (t).
You fire a ray of frost at (t).

abilities.name: Acid Splash
abilities.description: Hurl a bubble of acid at a creature.
attack_descs: You conjure a sizzling bubble of acid and hurl it at (t).
A splash of corrosive acid flies toward (t).

abilities.name: Chromatic Orb
abilities.description: You hurl an orb of energy that deals damage of a type you choose.
attack_descs: You conjure a swirling orb of multicolored energy and hurl it at (t).
A vibrant orb of magical force streaks toward (t).
attack_misses: (t) dodges the swirling orb of energy.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.description: You surround yourself with a protective magical force.
attack_descs: You weave threads of magic around your body, creating a protective barrier.

name: Runeblade
description: A warrior combining arcane magic with martial prowess. Based losely on Flesh and Blood's Runeblade class. High strength and intelligence, with a focus on powerful weapon attacks and rune magic.

abilities.name: Arcanic Crackle
abilities.description: You can imbue your weapon with arcane energy, dealing 1d6 damage plus intelligence modifier
attack_descs: You channel arcane energy into your weapon, causing it to crackle with power as you strike (t).
Your weapon hums with arcane energy as you unleash a powerful attack against (t).
attack_misses: You attempt to channel arcane energy into your weapon, but (t) dodges your strike.
Your weapon hums with arcane energy, but (t) manages to block your attack.

abilities.name: Douse in Runeblood
abilities.description: The blood around you hums with power, granting a boost to your strength and intelligence for 3 turns.
attack_descs: Dousing your weapon in blood, you sketch a rune, empowering it with arcane energy. You feel a surge of power course through you as the rune takes effect.

abilities.name: Runechant
abilities.description: Chanting, you release a surge of magical energy at your enemy, dealing 1d12 damage modified by intelligence.
attack_descs: You chant an ancient incantation, releasing a surge of magical energy that strikes (t) with devastating force.
With a powerful chant, you unleash a wave of arcane energy that crashes into (t), dealing significant damage.
attack_misses: You chant an ancient incantation, but (t) manages to evade the surge of magical energy.
With a powerful chant, you unleash a wave of arcane energy, but (t) dodges out of the way.

abilities.name: Runic Reclamation
abilities.description: Striking your opponent, you can reclaim some runic energy from your target, sapping their strength and dexterity
attack_descs: You strike (t) with a powerful blow, siphoning off some of their strength and dexterity as you do.
attack_misses: You attempt to strike (t) and siphon off their strength and dexterity, but they manage to evade your attack.
